entries.title: The Long Dark
entries.definitive_edition: The Long Dark on Windows PC with Tales from the Far Territory

emulation.notes: Use a native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC build with Tales from the Far Territory available
primary.why: The PC version is the original full-release route, has the highest practical capture/settings ceiling, and received the visual-enhancement work first. The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S native versions are strong high-fidelity console routes, but they do not add sourced exclusive gameplay over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current PC version through Steam, Epic, GOG, or Microsoft Store, and add Tales from the Far Territory if you want the expanded Survival Mode content.

entries.remaster_caveats: The native PS5/Xbox Series versions and visual-enhancement update are improved ports/updates, not separate game entries. Tales from the Far Territory is paid Survival Mode expansion content.
